email.subject1: a signal play for Standard AI
email.body1:
Ed, saw Standard AI acquire Pathr.ai and lean fully into VISION Analytics across 24 countries.

A pivot and acquisition at that scale usually opens more in-market retailers than the sales team can personally cover before the new positioning cools, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Standard AI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ed, quick follow-up for Standard AI.

Repositioning around a new platform usually means the pipeline target jumps faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Standard AI needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ed, last bit of proof for Standard AI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Standard AI's reply rate likely compares to other AI startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ed, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating an acquisition while repositioning a platform is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a retail-analytics motion? I will tailor it to Standard AI either way.
